brothers_parlor._comment: Invrisil 8c C1 FIX ITERATION 3 (controller windowed read: Wilovan still a silhouette on a near-black floor). The biggest lever per the controller's own ordering: the FLOOR pick. The scan-derived library Tiles.png (23,4) 'warm wood' candidate read near-black in-engine (picks.md's own windowed-check-required caveat proved right) -- replaced with the inn biome's OWN floor, Interior_Walls_01 [1,21] warm plank: already screenshot-verified as a warm LIT room read in the game's most-photographed map, zero new pick risk. Skirt likewise reuses the inn's verified [7,21] grey-stone surround ('the warm floor pops as a lit room against dark surround' -- the inn's own _comment_skirt rationale, which is exactly the hideout-interior read wanted here). Blocked keeps the warm Wall_Tiles [2,2] stone from iteration 1. TRACED, not assumed: atmosphere.gd's light_multiplier is GLOBAL-phase (meta.light_energy_by_phase day=0.0), so the card-table hero light contributes ZERO at day phase -- the canonical's parlor shot is day, which is why the light lever couldn't fix the 04 murk and the floor/tint/vignette levers had to.
